metadata.title: The Eighth-Order Evolution Model for Closed Planar Curves
metadata.abstract: We consider the $L^2(ds)$ gradient flow of $\frac12\int k_{ss}^2\,ds$ for smooth closed immersed planar curves. The stationary curves are precisely the multiply covered circles. We give an explicit sufficient condition under which the elastic energy is non-increasing and for each nonzero turning number, explicit small initial scale-invariant energy yields a global smooth solution with bounded positive length and exponential convergence to a fixed multiply covered circle, after reparametrisation. We note that that the qualitative rigidity and convergence results are already contained in the generalised ideal flow theory of McCoy and Wheeler. The present paper gives quantitative measure of small initial data, corrected evolution identities, and a complete argument in the case of the curvature energy $\frac12\int k_{ss}^2\,ds$.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 高阶曲线流的定量完善
analysis.workSummary: 研究平面闭浸入曲线能量 (1/2)∫k_ss² ds 的八阶 L² 梯度流，给出非零转数下显式小能量条件、全局光滑解及重参数化后的指数圆收敛。
analysis.breakthrough: 贡献在定量阈值、修正恒等式和该能量情形的完整论证。
analysis.limitations: 作者明确指出定性刚性与收敛已包含于既有广义 ideal flow 理论，不宜宣称首次定性发现。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 对高阶几何流定量估计有用，创新范围较聚焦。
